parsed.claim: The trivial group (PUnit) satisfies SoficGroups.Sofic. This shows that the PermutationModel and GoodOn definitions, including the map_one field and the restriction ε<1, can be satisfied by a concrete instance. The sofic property is therefore not vacuously false.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_trivial_sofic : SoficGroups.Sofic PUnit := by
  refine ⟨fun F ε hε _ => ⟨⟨1, one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro g _ h _
    simp [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming, hε]
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
